item.title: EplayerX 1.2.53
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改进详情页内存管理，在连续浏览影片、相似内容和播放页面时及时释放隐藏页面的背景图。 - 改进返回详情页时的背景图恢复。 - 改进网络和文件读取错误处理，修复部分影片接近片尾时重复尝试恢复播放的问题。 - 优化首页媒体库卡片的绘制，减少滚动时的实时模糊开销。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved detail-page memory management by releasing hidden backdrop images while browsing titles, similar content, and playback pages. - Improved backdrop restoration when returning to a detail page. - Improved handling of network and file-reading errors, and fixed repeated playback recovery attempts near the end of some videos. - Optimized Home library card rendering to reduce live-blur overhead while scrolling.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
